title: The Magnetic Shear Convoys
logline: When a severe magnetic shear destabilizes jump gates across three systems, three stranded freight convoys must link behind a single hardened shield ship, sparking a bitter conflict over which ships' cargo must be jettisoned to survive the crossing.

roles.description: Senior convoy navigator; exhausted, steady, trying to get three hundred stranded crew across the shear line.
Representative for the high-value commercial haulers; sharp, calculating, unwilling to dump precious industrial parts.
Master of an overcrowded relief and refugee transport; defiant, terrified of being abandoned in the dark.
A massive ice-sheathed bulk tractor with polarized magnetic deflector plates.
The regional guild of independent freight pilots stranded across the three systems.
The trading syndicate owning the bulk industrial cargo containers.
A crowded orbital weigh-station in the departure system where the convoys form up.
The safe orbital jump nexus on the far side of the storm.

public_situation: Regional jump gates shut down across three systems as a massive magnetic shear front sweeps through, leaving three merchant and refugee convoys stranded at {role:staging_depot}.
private_truth: The magnetic wake cast by {role:shield_vessel} can only protect two-thirds of the combined convoy tonnage; the rest must jettison cargo or be left behind in the shear zone.

beats.public_change: Emergency warning beacons pulse amber across three star systems as jump gates lock down.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver dense cuprite ore to wind superconducting umbilical couplers linking the convoy ships to the shield vessel.
missions.private_fact: Three smaller haulers in the relief fleet already have cracked drive coils and cannot jump independently.

beats.public_change: The linked convoy enters the intermediate shear zone as magnetic friction turns hull plating white-hot.

missions.reason: Scan the lead ship's sensor array to plot magnetic field lines and map a stable transit channel through the turbulence.
missions.private_fact: The merchants' advocate secretly bribed the lead tug engineer to keep commercial container barges in the dead center of the magnetic wake.

beats.public_change: Shear forces climb forty percent higher than projected, causing magnetic coupling cables to snap like violin strings.

missions.reason: A rogue shear vortex broke loose an uncrewed ballast barge; destroy its adrift wreckage and recover its emergency tow tether.
missions.private_fact: The ballast barge was deliberately weighted down with smuggled luxury spirits belonging to the conglomerate.

beats.public_change: The convoy approaches the final jump gate into {role:destination_nexus} as the shield ship's deflectors begin to overload.

missions.reason: Hostile salvage raiders trailing the convoy attack the rear guard; destroy the raider vanguard before they breach the convoy's trailing lifepods.
missions.private_fact: The raiders were hired by a competitor who wants the commercial cargo destroyed to corner destination markets.

missions.reason: Carry the emergency transit registry through the gate to clear terminal docks for the surviving ships.
missions.private_fact: The marshal intends to step down as soon as the fleet docks.

player_choice.prompt: The shield ship's deflectors are burning out on the final approach. Mass must be shed immediately to survive the transit.

options.label: Force the merchants to jettison their industrial cargo containers, prioritizing human passengers and relief ships
Sever the tow lines to the trailing refugee transports to protect the commercial investment and industrial goods
Redline the shield ship's reactor to full overload, attempting to drag all ships through together

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot orders the industrial cargo dumped to ensure all ships survive.
resolutions.summary: Every crew and refugee survives the transit. Millions in industrial cargo are lost to the shear, leaving {role:commercial_conglomerate} furious.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced corporate haulers to dump their precious cargo into a magnetic storm so stranded refugees could make the jump.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot cuts the tow lines on the trailing refugee transports.
resolutions.summary: The valuable cargo reaches {role:destination_nexus} intact. The abandoned refugee transports drift into the shear zone, triggering immense sector outrage.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot overloads the shield ship's reactor to pull the entire fleet across.
resolutions.summary: The fleet crosses the shear line together, but {role:shield_vessel} burns out its engines permanently on arrival, a glorious scarred wreck.

resolutions.reached_by: The couplers fail or the pilot never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: The convoy disintegrates in the intermediate shear zone. Scattered ships drift without deflection shielding, suffering devastating casualties across the sector.

loose_threads.detail: Salvage futures for transit corridor wreckage were bought up by an anonymous syndicate hours before the convoys merged.
The magnetic deflector control console on {role:shield_vessel} carries an override chip registered to a private security firm.
Passenger rolls for the relief fleet show thirty family names stamped with forged transit permits from a border world.

radio_hooks: Transit commission declares regional jump lanes hazardous due to unprecedented magnetic shear front.
Independent freight convoys bottleneck at border checkpoints facing ruinous passage delays.
Logistics cartel defends private towing tariffs citing maintenance costs for polarized shield hulls.

voice_direction.fleet_marshal: Gravelly, calm, and bone-tired. Speaks with slow navigational authority, refusing to raise his voice even as alarms blare.
voice_direction.merchants_advocate: Crisp, aggressive, and entitled. Rapidly fires contract clauses and property valuations, treating tonnage as more valuable than lives.
voice_direction.relief_captain: Raw, fierce, and desperate. Speaks with a hoarse throat, pleading directly for her passengers and refusing all corporate jargon.
